Europe Yakult Co., Ltd., headquartered in the Netherlands (voting rights ownership ratio 100.0%), handles manufacturing and sales and oversees the management of each European subsidiary.

entries.a8a3c974fc561fa5: These are businesses in cosmetics, pharmaceuticals, professional baseball promotion, and others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥26,014 million. Cosmetics are manufactured by the company and sold by Yakult sales companies across Japan. Professional baseball promotion is conducted by Yakult Kyudan Co., Ltd., a consolidated subsidiary (voting rights ownership ratio 80.0%).

entries.c2126469f5867b03: In Asia and Oceania, local subsidiaries mainly manufacture and sell dairy products. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥136,209 million. Consolidated subsidiaries include China Yakult Co., Ltd., Guangzhou Yakult Co., Ltd., Malaysia Yakult Co., Ltd. and Vietnam Yakult Co., Ltd., among others. Myanmar Yakult Co., Ltd. is currently temporarily suspended. Korea Yakult Co., Ltd., an equity-method affiliate (ownership of voting rights 38.3%), also manufactures and sells dairy products and others in this region.
entries.d64d25f2ae3fddb8: This business manufactures dairy products and noodles in Japan, purchases soft drinks, and sells them through Yakult sales companies nationwide. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥220,386 million, the largest category among the reportable segments. The company manufactures dairy products, and some manufacturing processes are outsourced to consolidated subsidiaries such as Iwate Yakult Factory Co., Ltd. Sales are handled by 106 Yakult sales companies nationwide, of which 21 are consolidated subsidiaries, including Tokyo Yakult Sales Co., Ltd.
